final: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) as total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) as expense_count FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget GROUP BY b.budget_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_total FROM budget_totals) SELECT AVG(bt.total_cost) as avg_of_above_avg_totals, SUM(bt.expense_count) as total_expenses_count, AVG(bt.total_cost - oa.avg_total) as avg_excess_over_average FROM budget_totals bt CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE bt.total_cost > oa.avg_total    -- Returns: avg $130.95, 23 total expenses, avg excess $90.83
